snippet.title: Tactris - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Tactris is a rogue-like strategic puzzler about slotting soldiers.
Stack up your formations of units and take on waves of enemies, bosses and more as you collect powerful upgrades and try to defeat the root of the encroaching evil!
